meta.title: Document OCR and Auto-Fill: not available on plans below Growth
gaps: Sign in as a Vendor on a tenant below the Growth plan.
Use Document OCR and Auto-Fill on uploaded documents and verify the capability is unavailable or refused below Growth.
Repeat the same OCR and Auto-Fill workflow on a Growth tenant and verify it is available and works.
Compare the same user role and steps across tenants with different subscription plans.
warnings: can only test part of this — no step for: Sign in as a Vendor on a tenant below the Growth plan.; Use Document OCR and Auto-Fill on uploaded documents and verify the capability is unavailable or refused below Growth.; Repeat the same OCR and Auto-Fill workflow on a Growth tenant and verify it is available and works.; Compare the same user role and steps across tenants with different subscription plans.

args.need: sign in as the Vendor on a below-Growth tenant and a Growth tenant, run Document OCR and Auto-Fill on uploaded documents in both, and verify it is unavailable below Growth but works on Growth

steps.note: The catalog cannot select subscription plans, access the Document OCR and Auto-Fill workflow, upload documents for OCR, or compare its behavior across tenants.
Confirm the session remains free of a crash or server error after the tester completes the unavailable workflow.
